records.jp: はい、コーヒーです
records.en_original: Here's your coffee.
records.en: Here's your coffee.

records.jp: ありがとう。<CR>……あのさ、正直なこと言っていい？
records.en_original: Thanks. ...Hey, can I be honest about something?
records.en: Thanks. ...Hey, can I be honest about something?

records.jp: 何ですか？
records.en_original: What is it?
records.en: What is it?

records.jp: 綺麗すぎて落ち着かない
records.en_original: This place is just TOO tidy. I can't relax.
records.en: This place is just TOO tidy. I can't relax.

records.jp: それはそっちの教室が散らかりすぎなんですよ
records.en_original: Anywhere is tidy compared to your room.
records.en: Anywhere is tidy compared to your room.

records.jp: いやいや、その方が使いやすいんだって。<CR>どこに何があるかは把握してるし
records.en_original: No no, that's how I like it! That way I know where everything is.
records.en: No no, that's how I like it! That way I know where everything is.

records.jp: それ、片付けが苦手な人たちみんな言いますよね
records.en_original: That's what all people who hate cleaning say.
records.en: That's what all people who hate cleaning say.

records.jp: ははは……
records.en_original: Hahaha...
records.en: Hahaha...

records.jp: 一回本腰入れて整頓してみたらいいですよ。<CR>やっぱり綺麗な方がいいってなりますから
records.en_original: You should try cleaning up once in a while. You'll find that a tidy room is much better.
records.en: You should try cleaning up once in a while. You'll find that a tidy room is much better.

records.jp: 詩帆さんが手伝ってくれるなら
records.en_original: Only if you give me a hand.
records.en: Only if you give me a hand.

records.jp: 結局わたしが全部やる未来が見えました
records.en_original: I see a future in which I am the one doing all the work.
records.en: I see a future in which I am the one doing all the work.

records.jp: いやいや～、さすがにそんなことは。<CR>できる人とやった方が効率良いかなって思っただけ
records.en_original: I wouldn't do that to you! I just think it'd be more efficient to work with someone who knows what they're doing.
records.en: I wouldn't do that to you! I just think it'd be more efficient to work with someone who knows what they're doing.

records.jp: ……少しだけですよ
records.en_original: Fine... But just a little.
records.en: Fine... But just a little.

records.jp: やったー！
records.en_original: Yay!
records.en: Yay!

records.jp: え～、それはちょっとめんどい～
records.en_original: Ughhh, but it's such a pain!
records.en: Ughhh, but it's such a pain!

records.jp: それじゃいつまで経っても……
records.en_original: At this rate your room will never be clean.
records.en: At this rate your room will never be clean.

records.jp: 整った部屋が見たくなったら、こっちに来るから。<CR>遊びに来る口実にさせてよ
records.en_original: If I want to see a tidy room, I'll just come here. It'll be a good excuse to come hang out with you!
records.en: If I want to see a tidy room, I'll just come here. It'll be a good excuse to come hang out with you!

records.jp: もう、困ったらすぐそういうこと言って<CR>誤魔化すんですから
records.en_original: You always say that kind of thing to get yourself out of trouble.
records.en: You always say that kind of thing to get yourself out of trouble.

records.jp: 星崎さん、コーヒーのお代わりは要りますか？
records.en_original: Would you like a refill, Ao?
records.en: Would you like a refill, Ao?

records.jp: 大丈夫、ありがとう！
records.en_original: I'm fine, thanks!
records.en: I'm fine, thanks!

records.jp: 星崎さん、スイカありますけど<CR>食べます？
records.en_original: Ao, would you like some watermelon?
records.en: Ao, would you like some watermelon?

records.jp: あのー、詩帆さん？
records.en_original: Umm... Shiho?
records.en: Umm... Shiho?

records.jp: そこまでしなくて大丈夫だよ。<CR>遊びに来ただけなんだから
records.en_original: You really don't need to do all that. I just came to hang out.
records.en: You really don't need to do all that. I just came to hang out.

records.jp: 気を遣わないでください。<CR>これはわたしがやりたくてやっていることなので
records.en_original: Please don't worry about me. I'm doing it because I want to.
records.en: Please don't worry about me. I'm doing it because I want to.

records.jp: そうなの？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: はい。色々考えておもてなしするのが楽しいんです
records.en_original: Yes. I enjoy entertaining and thinking about what I can do for my guests.
records.en: Yes. I enjoy entertaining and thinking about what I can do for my guests.

records.jp: じゃあ、スイカ貰っちゃおうかな
records.en_original: Well in that case, maybe I will have some watermelon.
records.en: Well in that case, maybe I will have some watermelon.

records.jp: はーい、よろこんで！
records.en_original: Coming right up!
records.en: Coming right up!

records.jp: 詩帆さんもくつろぎなよ
records.en_original: You should sit down and relax too, Shiho!
records.en: You should sit down and relax too, Shiho!

records.jp: いえ、わたしは大丈夫ですから
records.en_original: I'm fine, really.
records.en: I'm fine, really.

records.jp: せっかく詩帆さんと遊びにきたのに<CR>放っておかれたら寂しいよ～
records.en_original: I came here to hang out with you but all you do is ignore me...
records.en: I came here to hang out with you but all you do is ignore me...

records.jp: あっ、そうですよね……
records.en_original: O-oh, right...
records.en: O-oh, right...

records.jp: じゃあ、この片付けが終わったら、<CR>お言葉に甘えて休憩しますね
records.en_original: I guess I'll take a little break once I've finished cleaning up here.
records.en: I guess I'll take a little break once I've finished cleaning up here.

records.jp: うんうん、そうして
records.en_original: Sounds good!
records.en: Sounds good!

records.jp: あっつ！！
records.en_original: Aah!
records.en: Aah!

records.jp: 大丈夫ですか！？
records.en_original: Are you okay?!
records.en: Are you okay?!

records.jp: うん、やけどとかはしてないけど<CR>……詩帆さんが淹れてくれたコーヒー、こぼしちゃった
records.en_original: Yeah, I'm fine. But I spilled the coffee you made for me, Shiho...
records.en: Yeah, I'm fine. But I spilled the coffee you made for me, Shiho...

records.jp: そんなこと……また淹れればいいんです
records.en_original: Oh, you don't have to worry about that... I can always make more.
records.en: Oh, you don't have to worry about that... I can always make more.

records.jp: とにかく、大丈夫ならよかったです。<CR>ふきん取ってきますね
records.en_original: I'm just glad you're okay. I'll go get a towel.
records.en: I'm just glad you're okay. I'll go get a towel.

records.jp: 詩帆さん……
records.en_original: Shiho...
records.en: Shiho...

records.jp: お母さんみたい
records.en_original: You're like a mom.
records.en: You're like a mom.

records.jp: それってどういう意味ですか？
records.en_original: And just what do you mean by that?
records.en: And just what do you mean by that?

records.jp: あはは、そういうとこも
records.en_original: Ahaha, you even sound like a mom!
records.en: Ahaha, you even sound like a mom!

records.jp: それ、絶対いい意味じゃないでしょう
records.en_original: That's definitely not a compliment.
records.en: That's definitely not a compliment.

records.jp: いやいや、面倒見が良いってこと！
records.en_original: No no, I mean the way you look after me. It's a good thing!
records.en: No no, I mean the way you look after me. It's a good thing!

records.jp: それに詩帆さんが笑ってくれると安心するし。<CR>ほら、さっきとかさ
records.en_original: And your smile always makes me feel better. I even felt it just now.
records.en: And your smile always makes me feel better. I even felt it just now.

records.jp: だったらいいですけど……
records.en_original: Well that's good, I guess...
records.en: Well that's good, I guess...

records.jp: お嫁さんにしたいわー
records.en_original: I want to make you my wife!
records.en: I want to make you my wife!

records.jp: な、何言ってるんですか！？
records.en_original: Wh-what are you talking about?!
records.en: Wh-what are you talking about?!

records.jp: 旦那様より、詩帆さんみたいなお嫁さんが欲しい
records.en_original: I'd rather have a wife like you than a husband!
records.en: I'd rather have a wife like you than a husband!

records.jp: で、でも星崎さんは女の子でしょう？
records.en_original: B-but you're a girl, Ao!
records.en: B-but you're a girl, Ao!

records.jp: えー、だめー？<CR>優しくするよー？
records.en_original: So? What's wrong with that? I'll be good to you!
records.en: So? What's wrong with that? I'll be good to you!

records.jp: もう、変なこと言わないでください
records.en_original: Stop it... You're being weird.
records.en: Stop it... You're being weird.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
